item.title: Washington floods: Evacuations, road closures and Trump signs emergency declaration—what to know
item.description: Western Washington is grappling with severe flooding after an atmospheric river caused major river overflows and evacuations. Governor Ferguson announced a delay in the state budget rollout due to the crisis, but federal disaster aid has been approved. Road closures, including US-12 due to a landslide, and power outages continue to impact communities.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: US-seized tanker carrying Venezuelan crude sails toward Houston: Report
item.description: A massive oil tanker, the Skipper, carrying over 1.8 million barrels of Venezuelan crude, has been seized by the US and is reportedly en route to Houston. This move, part of a heightened pressure campaign against President Maduro, has intensified US-Venezuela tensions. Guyana's maritime authority confirmed the tanker was falsely flying its flag, adding another layer to the unfolding situation.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Jail, fines or deportation? What Ted Cruz said about claims over Ilhan Omar’s marriage to brother
item.description: Senator Ted Cruz suggested Representative Ilhan Omar could face severe penalties, including imprisonment and deportation, if allegations of marrying her brother for US entry are true. He cited federal marriage fraud, Minnesota's incest law, and potential tax fraud. President Trump also revived these unsubstantiated claims, which Omar denies.

item.title: CDawgVA criticizes modern IRL streaming and raises concerns about public harassment and consent
item.description: Popular IRL streamer CDawgVA has voiced concerns over the genre's evolution, lamenting a shift from genuine exploration to intrusive crowd filming. He criticizes streamers who film unsuspecting strangers without consent, leading to thousands of viewers mocking them. This debate highlights growing community unease about harassment and ethical boundaries in live streaming.

item.title: "It’s not my community": TheBurntPeanut denies fans targeted Ironmouse as VTuber Awards controversy unfolds
item.description: The Streamer Awards 2025 fallout continues as TheBurntPeanut denies his community harassed Ironmouse after she defended his controversial win. Ironmouse remains caught in the crossfire, facing harassment from multiple sides.

item.description: The seventeen-year-old streamer RaKai's meteoric rise in 2025 is fueled by significant controversies. item.title: 'Sanskrit ours too': Pak varsity launches course; Mahabharat, Gita on the cards
item.description: In a historic move, Pakistan's Lahore University of Management Sciences (LUMS) has introduced a Sanskrit course, marking a significant first since partition. The curriculum includes Hindu epics like the Mahabharata and Gita. Academics emphasize Sanskrit's regional unifying role and aim to foster local scholarship on ancient texts, previously dominated by foreign researchers.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Everyone except the Indian? Popular entertainment account called out for not naming Dhalsim actor Vidyut Jamwal in Street Fighter cast reveal
item.description: In a recent reveal by DiscussingFilm on social media, the cast list for the upcoming Street Fighter movie ignited a storm of controversy, notably for the absence of Indian actor Vidyut Jammwal, who was set to embody the character Dhalsim.

item.title: Triple homicide: 15-year-old Texas boy kills ex-girlfriend’s younger siblings and mother
item.description: A 15-year-old boy is in custody after allegedly committing a brutal triple homicide in Odessa, Texas, killing his ex-girlfriend's mother and two younger siblings. The teen reportedly changed his plans from targeting the ex-girlfriend to attacking her family at their apartment. The motive remains unclear as the community reels from the shocking violence.

item.title: Birthday gone wrong: Young man arrested by Dubai police for setting street on fire
item.description: The young man was arrested by Dubai Police after setting a public road on fire with a flammable substance to celebrate his birthday. The reckless act, recorded on social media, endangered lives, disrupted traffic, and damaged infrastructure. Authorities fined him Dh2,000, imposed 23 black points, and impounded his vehicle for 60 days, warning against such dangerous stunts online.
